purpose: Decide whether a queue item can skip the model's triage turn. Never rewrites, reorders or drops an item.

instructions.question: What kind of queue item is item.text?

criteria.specific_task: Names the file or component to change and a checkable result
criteria.vague_goal: A broad wish with no named place to change and no checkable result
criteria.owner_decision: Asks someone to decide, choose, pick or approve between business options

build.does: the loop builds the item as written; a wrong call costs one tick and a revert

owner.does: park the item under 'waiting on the owner'; a wrong call costs the owner a glance

triage.does: the model triages it as it would have without the gate (sharpen, confirm done, split, drop)

calibration.threshold_from: fixtures/queue-triage/tune.jsonl only: build cases score 0.62-0.75 on specific_task, the highest other case 0.60; 0.65 gives up one build case for margin. Owner cases score 0.53-1.00 (one at 0.21), the highest other case 0.35.
calibration.note: A noul asking whether item.history shows the work already shipped was tried and removed: it scored 0.04-0.26 on three of four shipped items. KEV does not compare two texts reliably; leave that to git or to triage.
